nodes.label: Refresh the service default map from the external airspace-list API.
The live response cannot be converted into a usable default map.
Approximate a metric circle as a regular lon/lat polygon.
Accept plain vertices, GeoJSON Polygon coordinates, JSON text, or WKT.
Convert the live paged response into the v3.2 default-map contract.
Fetch every page and return one response-shaped aggregate.
Atomically keep the latest valid response as the next-start fallback.
Refresh at service startup, falling back to the last valid file.
